description: We're the robotics team from Al-Bayan Bilingual School (BBS) in Kuwait, with experience competing in national and international robotics Olympiads. We've spent years building and programming robots for competitions and are now taking on a different kind of challenge. For NASA Space Apps 2026 we're working on Flame in Freefall to explore how AI can help researchers better understand combustion in space and improve spacecraft fire safety.
